title: What are the most important qualities of a good coworker?
text:
# Part 1
I strongly believe that being helpful and experienced are the most important qualities of a good coworker.

# Part 2 S
For example, right after I graduated from college, I started to work in the marketing department at ABC company./ As a newbie, I had no experience and had to handle many different tasks by myself.

# Part 3 T
I had a lot on my plate, worked day and night, and the office atmosphere was tense. I felt extremely stressed and exhausted.

# Part 4 A
Fortunately, my coworker Tom was a very caring guy. Since he had a lot of experience, he was willing to help me and gave me many useful tips and advice. He patiently went through everything from A to Z with me.

# Part 5 R
Thanks to his help, I got used to my work and learned skills quickly. Eventually, my performance was great, and I even got promoted and received bonuses at the end of the year.

# Part 6
Therefore, working with a supportive and experienced colleague can truly make a huge difference.
